title: Bruxolixer's Bedrock Breaker
description: Adds a tool which allows you to break bedrock in paper servers.
body:
The plugin restores ability to break bedrock on paper servers by simply introducing a craftable tool which in a cool sequence _melts_ or _evaporates_ the bedrock away...

### Features:
1. - Adds custom tool
2. - Allows players to destroy bedrock by using the tool
3. - Plays a custom breaking sequence
4. - Simple and lightweight
5. - Works on modern versions

### Crafting reciepe:
1. > - TNT | Obsidian | TNT
1. > - Obsidian | Diamond Block | Obsidian
1. > - TNT | Obsidian | TNT

I tested it on paper 1.21.11
